user.title: Salus account
user.description: The account of the Salus iT500 mobile app (the same login as salus-it500.com).

data_description.password: If the password contains special characters and login fails, try it without them: Salus strips them when the password is created.

reauth_confirm.title: Salus account
reauth_confirm.description: Salus rejected the stored credentials. Enter them again.

abort.no_devices: No thermostat is registered on this account.
abort.wrong_account: This account does not own the configured thermostat.

data_description.scan_interval: Reads the copy kept by the Salus cloud. Does not wake the thermostat, so it costs no battery.
data_description.wake_interval: The thermostat reports only when a value changes. Waking it forces a full report within seconds but uses battery. Commands always wake it.
